dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, look! I have a new phone.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈlʊk! aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈnuː ˈfoʊn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! Can I have your number?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! kən aɪ ˈhæv jʊr ˈnʌmbər?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Sure. It's zero nine one, two three four, five six seven eight.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ɪts ˈzɪroʊ ˈnaɪn ˈwʌn, ˈtuː ˈθriː ˈfɔːr, ˈfaɪv ˈsɪks ˈsɛvən ˈeɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks! Oh, my phone! Sorry, Emma. Can I call you later?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! ˈoʊ, maɪ ˈfoʊn! ˈsɑːri, ˈɛmə. kən aɪ ˈkɔːl juː ˈleɪtər?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Sure! Answer the phone! Talk to you later!
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr! ˈænsər ðə ˈfoʊn! ˈtɔːk tə juː ˈleɪtər!
